answers.text:
# Coastal Lights Registry

The registry lists every light on the Selk coast, north to south, with a note on each.

## 1. Ashcombe Point Light

First lit in 1793. The tower stands 19 m above the high-water line and its light carries 14 nautical miles in clear weather. Keepers lived on site until the light was automated; the cottages now hold a small display of logbooks, lamp parts and charts of the reefs it guards. Access is by the coast path only, and the gallery is closed to visitors in winter. The fog signal was removed when the light was automated, and the station is checked by a maintenance crew twice a year. Records of shipwrecks nearby are kept at the county archive, not on site.
